_about: Revision 1 of the bus-service-notices dataset (skku_content.datasets, _id bus-service-notices): each service's notices and suspension, a copy of that revision as stored in skku_content and skku_content_dev by the push of 2026-10-19 18:13 UTC (2026-10-20 KST; skku_content_dev at 17:51 UTC), checked equal to skku_content read only on 2026-10-20, keys in stored order. Production serves the shuttle schedule routes and feeds the estimate pollers from it since PR #293. The data tool pushed this data with _about removed. Nothing trimmed.
